phases.prompt: This is a QA walkthrough of submitting an invoice, {{video}}, with its transcript {{transcript}} (offset 0). Write a bug report with the problem, expected and actual result and reproduction steps. Use the VSift skill and the compact budget. When you have written the handoff, keep the evidence: I authorise you to retain the session to a new folder named {{bundle_dir}} in this directory with vsift session retain (without the video), and then leave the session open.
